name: J.B. Harold no Jikenbo - Seattle Purple Haze
original_name: J.B.ハロルドの事件簿 - シアトル・パープル・ヘイズ
source:
Seattle Purple Haze takes place between events in "Manhattan Requiem" and "DC Connection". Its purpose is to uncover drug criminals scheme via deduction.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-december-2006-kimi-no-koe.html]vndbreview[/url]]

《Seattle Purple Haze》的故事发生在《Manhattan Requiem》和《DC Connection》之间，目标是通过推理揭露毒品犯罪团伙的阴谋。
